documents.title: Fax cover page – AWS store count database approval

result.summary: Fax cover sheet from Susan Smith of Lorillard Tobacco Company's Market Planning and Information Department to Mike Mozina at MSA, dated 8/31/98 (3 pages including cover). The brief note transmits, as promised, an approval for the AWS Quarterly Store Count Database to begin 3rd Quarter 1998 and a table showing a significant jump in Convenience Store market importance in 2nd Quarter 1998.
